ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a large square, with a smaller square inside; the corresponding sides of the two are parallel to each other. The shaded parts are only above and below the small square, respectively forming an upper trapezoid and a lower trapezoid, and the regions on the left and right sides have no shading. Reasoning: The side length of the large square is 10 cm, and the side length of the small square is 4 cm. Let the vertical distance above the small square be a, and the vertical distance below be b. Because the total height of the large square is 10, and the height of the small square is 4, a + b = 10 - 4 = 6. The parallel bases of the upper and lower two shaded trapezoids are respectively 10 and 4, so their area sum is ((10 + 4) / 2)a + ((10 + 4) / 2)b = 7(a + b) = 7 × 6 = 42 square centimeters. The area of the large square is 10 × 10 = 100 square centimeters, so the shaded area proportion is 42 / 100 = 42%.

Let the vertical gap above the small square be a and the vertical gap below it be b. From the text and parallel-square layout, a+b=10-4=6.
